title: How Ondo Finance plans to bring tokenized US stocks to Solana
summary: Ondo plans to launch tokenized US stocks and ETFs on Solana in 2026, using custody-backed assets, onchain transfers and embedded compliance.

title: Crypto downturn reveals gap between VC valuations and market cap
summary: Several VC-backed crypto projects now trade at market capitalizations well below the valuations assigned during their last private funding rounds.

title: Philippines blocks Coinbase, Gemini amid wider crackdown on unlicensed VASPs
summary: Philippine regulators are tightening control over crypto access, signaling that global exchanges must secure local licenses to operate.

title: Trend Research quietly becomes one of Ethereum’s largest whales with 46K ETH buy
summary: Trend Research’s 46,379 ETH purchase vaults the private company into the top tier of ETH treasuries, behind only SharpLink Gaming and BitMine Immersion Technologies.

title: HashKey secures $250M for new crypto fund amid ‘significant interest’
summary: HashKey Capital has raised $250 million in commitments for the first close of its fourth crypto fund amid continued institutional demand despite volatile market conditions.

title: Extended crypto ETF outflows shows institutions disengaging: Glassnode
summary: Bitcoin and Ether ETFs have recorded sustained outflows since early November, which Glassnode says signals institutional disengagement.

title: Bitcoin ‘never crossed’ $100K if adjusted for inflation, says Alex Thorn
summary: Galaxy’s Alex Thorn says Bitcoin's $126,000 peak translates to $99,848 after being adjusted for inflation, falling short of its milestone six-figure mark.

title: Amplify ETFs for stablecoins, tokenization go live for trading
summary: Two new exchange-traded funds from Amplify track companies building the infrastructure for stablecoins and tokenization, blending stocks and crypto.

title: Solana treasury Upexi slides 7.5% on $1B shelf registration filing
summary: Shares in Upexi fell 7.5% on Tuesday after it filed a $1 billion shelf registration, suggesting its Solana holdings may increase after over five months of no purchases.

title: Bitcoin treasury Matador’s $58M share-sale approved to expand holdings
summary: The Ontario Securities Commission has cleared Matador to raise $58 million, which it intends to use to expand its Bitcoin treasury.
